## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] CLI help/version or relevant manual commands checked
- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage

## Requirements and compatibility

- [ ] Clarification gating and explicit unapproved assumptions are preserved
- [ ] Mandatory citation instructions are consistent across all output formats
- [ ] No TODOs, stubs, mocks, or placeholder functionality was added
- [ ] Runtime dependency and supported-Python changes are documented
- [ ] No personal, confidential, or sensitive task data is included
